name: Brontosaurus
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
sourcePageKind: The public D&D Beyond source index lists this creature. The chapter and creature pages redirected to the book purchase page when checked without access.
sourceWitness: Public scan of the Wizards of the Coast English first printing. pp. 2, 95, and 96 show the credits, creature accounts, and stat blocks.
errataEvidence: No published correction for Brontosaurus located in the official Sage Advice & Errata index or D&D Beyond changelog. The errata index separately lists Volo’s Guide to Monsters and Mordenkainen’s Tome of Foes.
habitatEvidence: Forest and Grassland are listed in the D&D Beyond habitat tooltip for this record.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description of the previously generated, square parchment portrait selected in the roster.
artworkNote: Previously staged portrait reused at its existing runtime path.
sourceNotes: Both attacks have a printed reach of 20 ft. Only Stomp can knock the target prone.
